lines.text: Believers are to submit to rulers and authorities, malign no one, and be peaceable and gentle.
God poured out the Spirit through Moses, and justified by grace we become heirs with hope of eternal life.
Avoid foolish controversies, and reject a divisive man after seven warnings, since he is self-condemned.
The writer has decided to winter at Nicopolis and asks that Zenas the lawyer and Apollos be equipped.
